observations: Complete numbered overlay and all 96 small-component source/overlay crops inspected. Eye highlights and genuine enclosed triangular masonry/ornament gaps retained regardless of size. Explicit isolated acute tips excluded. Narrow interrupted upper-beak stripe and five masonry seam families reconnected only within their inspected paths; foreign-pane adjacency prohibited. Upper and middle heads, eye outlines/highlights, beak spaces, head bands and small inner contours remain distinct. Lower head has open facial strokes and long separate neck/background region. Masonry block faces and enclosing rims remain separate; repeated block and narrow-gap names identify feature and position. Curled leaves at the left and large feather-like shapes at right retain open vein strokes. Earlier geometry is retained and canonical art unchanged. Final overlay and uniform fill must be inspected before the receipt is recorded.
